messages:
Ana: Heads-up — thinking about a 'Spotlight' invite type for a few high-signal partners. Priority onboarding + focused eval trigger + reserved capacity. Acceptance criteria and ops handoff thoughts?

Mike: Love it. Two quick asks: 1) explicit SLA for latency/cost tracking during the spotlight window, 2) cap on concurrent spotlights so we don't blow Q2 capacity.

Vera: Ops can reserve 1 Dedicated node for 48–72h per partner by default. Anything longer requires a capacity commit. We need a short runbook for rollback if the model shows regressions.

Sam: For the eval trigger, propose a lightweight pipeline: 1) partner provides ~10 representative prompts + expected behavior, 2) run automated regression checks (token-distribution + top-k diffs), 3) human spot-check 5 outputs. If regression > 3% -> alert and pause rollout.

Ana: Draft acceptance checklist (working):
- Recruitment: signed NDA + 1-page use-case doc
- Onboarding: sample prompts + small test dataset (<=100 inputs)
- Eval gating: automated + 5 human spot-checks
- Success signals: qualitative >=4/5 on core flows, latency p95 <200ms (hosted) or agreed threshold for Dedicated, <=2 regressions first 7 days
- Ops: reserved slot + escalation contact info

Jess: Can we also add a scheduling window field to the invite email so partners know how long the reserved slot lasts? We need that to manage expectations.

Ana: Yep. Invite snippet idea:
> Hi {partner}, we'd like to offer you a Spotlight onboarding slot. It includes a reserved instance for 72h, a short eval run, and priority responses. Please confirm by replying with your sample prompts and preferred start window.

Vera: Add this to the canary/runbook pseudo: 
```
if eval_regression > 0.03:
  route_requests: fallback-compatible-model
  notify_channels: #eng-oncall, #product
  run: rollback_to_prev_model.sh
```
Also require partner contact in the escalation list.

Mike: Owner question — who will own partner follow-ups? PM or Eval owner?

Ana: I'll own recruitment and partner comms. Sam will own eval gating (running the checks + initial signoff). Vera owns reserved capacity and ops handoff.

Sam: I'll make a short Notion checklist and link it here when ready (prob later today).

prod-bot: New checklist created: https://notion.redwood/s/spotlight-onboard-checklist

Jess: Quick operational constraint: let's cap to 2 concurrent Spotlights this month unless Ops signs off extra capacity.

Ana: Agreed. Also asking product analytics to add metric: time-to-first-successful-call per partner (useful leading indicator).

Vera: Ops can feed that into Console; will add to the Spotlight dashboard.

Mike: I'll add a card to the roadmap board summarizing scope + risks (capacity and regression risk).

Ana: Thanks everyone — I'll produce a finalized invite + checklist and assign tasks.
